author: Marlon Chaviano
name: web-angular
title: Web app with Angular
description: Modern Angular: standalone components, signals, the new control flow and esbuild builds, from the official CLI.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Standalone components, state with `signal()`/`computed()` and templates with the new control flow (`@if`, `@for`). No new NgModules.
- Generate pieces with the CLI (`npx ng g component <name>`) to follow the project's conventions.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
